text:
Escalating: this bead needs human ratification before autonomous claim, on two policy-interpretation questions:

1. Which CA/B Forum S/MIME BR version? The bead body mentions 'S/MIME BR v1.0' but BR revisions accumulate quickly. As of 2026-05-11 the current published S/MIME BR is v1.1.0 (effective 2025-09-15) with v1.0.2 still cited in some CA/B Forum minutes. Authoritative-not-shipping framing requires pinning a specific revision in the rustdoc citations. Mark's call: which revision is the reference target — current published (v1.1.0), most recent fully-effective (v1.0.2), or 'follow whichever zlint pins this week' (defers to PKIX-amgn.8's zlint catalog ingestion)?

2. Test cert sourcing. Acceptance criterion 5 requires independently-sourced test certs per AGENTS.md test-integrity. Options:
   (a) Generate certs in-tree with openssl req using BR-compliant DN templates per tier. Cheap, but the generator itself is the oracle for 'does this match BR tier X' — non-independent at the policy level.
   (b) Pull certs from zlint's testdata/ (Apache-2.0, attributable). zlint is the de facto interpretation; if our profile types match zlint on these certs that's meaningful cross-validation, but ties us to whatever revision zlint pins.
   (c) Pull certs from pkilint fixtures. Similar to (b) with DigiCert's authorship.
   (d) Both (b) and (c) for cross-validation between zlint and pkilint interpretations.

Recommendation: defer (a), pursue (b) initially with the zlint version pinned in pkix-profiles-cabf/CHANGELOG, then optionally add (c) later. Mark's preference?

After ratification, decompose into three children (Organization / Sponsor / Individual) per the bead's existing 'Decomposition' section. Each child is a single profile + tests + rustdoc, sized for one autonomous-claim iteration.

Note: I am not blocked on this — I'm escalating it as a durable question so the next do-beads pass can pick it up after Mark answers. The bead stays open and unclaimed.

(Filed by do-beads autonomous loop, 2026-05-11.)
